description: Changes a saved segment's name, description or filter. `filter` sets the full new filter.

inputSchema.description: Fields you leave out stay as they are.

automated.description: true keeps people whose matched posts are mostly automated, like bots. false keeps the rest.

intents.description: Has a mention tagged with one of these intents.

keywordKinds.description: Only people with a mention of these keyword kinds.

linkHosts.description: People with a mention that links to one of these hosts or its subdomains.

maxFollowers.description: This many followers or fewer. People with an unknown count are left out.

minFollowers.description: This many followers or more. People with an unknown count are left out.

muted.description: true keeps only muted people and false only people who are not muted.

neverKeywordKinds.description: Excludes people who mentioned these keyword kinds.

newSinceDays.description: People first seen in the past this many days.

notIntents.description: Excludes people with a mention of these intents.

notPlatforms.description: Leaves out people who have an account on these platforms.

items.description: The platform. Review platforms are appstore, googleplay, trustpilot and googlemaps (a place's Google reviews).

notTags.description: Leaves out people with one of these tags.

ownerIds.description: People owned by one of these members, by user id. Use "none" for people without an owner.

platforms.description: Only people with a profile on one of these platforms.

items.description: The platform. Review platforms are appstore, googleplay, trustpilot and googlemaps (a place's Google reviews).

stages.description: Only people in one of these outreach stages.

items.description: The outreach stage your team has reached with this person.

tags.description: People with one of these tags.
